entry.settingsNote: {{count}} saved account(s) in the switch list. Switching reloads permissions and menus.

sheet.title: Switch account
sheet.subtitle: Only accounts you chose to save appear here · up to {{max}}
sheet.rejectedMeta: Sign-in is no longer valid, enter the password again
sheet.otherHostMeta: From another server, enter the password again
sheet.addSubtitle: Sign in with another username and password; not saved by default
sheet.unsavedHint: Accounts that are not saved need the password again after you switch away or sign out.
sheet.rowHint: Tap to switch, long-press to remove from the list

remove.title: Remove from list?
remove.message: After removal, {{name}} must enter the password again to switch back.

signOut.currentMessage: The server will end this sign-in and the account is removed from the switch list. The app then switches to the next account in the list, or returns to the sign-in page if there is none.
signOut.allMessage: This clears the switch list, signs out the current account and returns to the sign-in page.
signOut.settingsMessage: This phone has {{count}} more saved account(s) in the switch list.

blocked.onShiftMessage: Please clock out first, then switch.
blocked.busyMessage: Please finish what you're doing first.

confirmUnsaved.title: Switch account?
confirmUnsaved.message: {{name}} is not saved in the switch list. Switching signs this account out, and you will need the password to sign in again.

add.title: Add account
add.intro: After signing in you will switch to the new account.
add.forgot: Forgot your password? The email code reset on the sign-in page still works.
add.saveHelper: When checked, you can switch to it from "Switch account". When unchecked it signs in this once, and you need the password again after switching away or signing out.
add.unsavedWarning: {{name}} is not saved in the switch list and will be signed out when the new account signs in. You will need the password again.
add.listFull: The switch list is full (up to {{max}}). Remove one first, or uncheck to sign in just once.

relogin.title: Sign in again as {{name}}
relogin.subtitleExpired: The saved sign-in expired (unused for over 7 days)
relogin.subtitleRejected: The saved sign-in is no longer valid
relogin.notice: If the server can't be reached the account is kept and you only see "try again later". It is marked as needing sign-in only when the server clearly rejects it (invalid sign-in / account restricted).

overlay.title: Switching to {{name}}
overlay.stepClear: Stopping and clearing the current account's local data (cache / cart / picker)
overlay.stepFinish: Re-registering push and opening the workbench
overlay.hint: All input is blocked while switching, about 1–3 seconds

failures.needsRelogin: {{name}}'s sign-in is no longer valid. Please enter the password again.
failures.networkError: Can't reach the server. Please try again later.
failures.identityMismatch: The saved sign-in for this account doesn't match the server. Please sign in again.
failures.vaultFull: The switch list is full (up to {{max}}). Remove one before saving another.
failures.activationFailed: The switch didn't finish. Please sign in again.
failures.sameAccount: That is already the current account.
failures.unknownAccount: This account is not in the list. Please add it again.
failures.notAccountSession: The current sign-in type can't switch accounts.
